impact: Poland temporarily shut down ePUAP, the government platform citizens and businesses use to reach public services, after detecting and stopping a cyberattack. Officials explained that the platform was taken offline as a precaution, not because the attack caused any damage. There is also no public confirmation that attackers accessed government systems or stole sensitive data.
